summary: Options for the minimal callback: pretty_results, result_format (json/yaml), result_indentation and result_yaml_line_width.
questions: Can I get YAML output from ad hoc ansible commands?
How do I pretty print ad hoc command results?

answer_card.title: minimal callback options
answer_card.answer_md:
- `pretty_results` (2.13+): force pretty printing; defaults true with `yaml`, false with `json`. YAML mode may alter results for readability.
- `result_format` (`json` default or `yaml`, 2.13+)
- `result_indentation` (default 4, 2.20+; YAML handles 2 to 9 correctly)
- `result_yaml_line_width` (`default`, `no-break`, `terminal-width`, 2.21+)
